title: Status Command
description: Use this when you want a quick snapshot of the runtime environment — reports node version, cwd, and platform via /status-command without making any LLM calls.
author: sox-ecosystem

invocation.description: Call run(input: CommandInput) → CommandOutput. CommandInput: { args: string[] }. CommandOutput: { stdout: string, exitCode: number }. Invoked via /status-command slash command.
